name: Ban Naemha

attributes.attribute: lived in the sun-well Kil-na-Greina in Cork
visible only to those gifted with second sight

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ban Naemha is an Irish mythological being, also spelled Ban Naema. It is a magical fish of wisdom. It swims in a holy well. In Cork, the sun-well called Kil-na-Greina was its home. Only those gifted with second sight could see Ban Naemha. A ritual surrounded the well. People took three sips of the water. They crawled around the well three times between each drink. They offered a stone the size of a dove's egg with each circuit. Whether the ritual aimed to lure the fish or to honor the place is unclear.

okr.objective: Describe Ban Naemha, the magical fish of wisdom that lived in a Cork holy well.
